#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#define il inline
#define RG register
#define ll long long
#define N (250005)

using namespace std;

int f[N][18],c[18],ans[18],lg,m,n,k,rhl;
int fac[N],ifac[N],inv[N],cnt[N],v[N];

il void add(int *a,int *b,RG int fg){
  for (RG int i=0;i<lg;++i){
    a[i]+=fg?b[i]:(rhl-b[i]);
    if (a[i]>=rhl) a[i]-=rhl;
  }
  return;
}

il void mul(int *a,int *b){
  memset(c,0,sizeof(c));
  for (RG int i=0;i<lg;++i){
    if (!a[i]) continue;
    for (RG int j=0;i+j<lg;++j)
      c[i+j]=(1LL*a[i]*b[j]+c[i+j])%rhl;
  }
  memcpy(a,c,sizeof(c)); return;
}

il void fpm(int *a,RG int b){
  memset(ans,0,sizeof(ans)),ans[0]=1;
  while (b){
    if (b&1) mul(ans,a);
    if (b>>=1) mul(a,a);
  }
  memcpy(a,ans,sizeof(ans)); return;
}

il int qpow(RG int a,RG int b){
  RG int ans=1;
  while (b){
    if (b&1) ans=1LL*ans*a%rhl;
    if (b>>=1) a=1LL*a*a%rhl;
  }
  return ans;
}

int main(){
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
  freopen("game.in","r",stdin);
  freopen("game.out","w",stdout);
#endif
  cin>>n>>k>>rhl; if (n&1) cout<<qpow(k,n),exit(0);
  fac[0]=ifac[0]=f[0][0]=1; for (m=1;m<=n;m<<=1) ++lg;
  for (RG int i=1;i<=n;++i){
    inv[i]=i==1 ? 1 : 1LL*(rhl-rhl/i)*inv[rhl%i]%rhl;
    fac[i]=1LL*fac[i-1]*i%rhl,ifac[i]=1LL*ifac[i-1]*inv[i]%rhl;
    cnt[i]=cnt[i>>1]+(i&1),f[i][cnt[i]]=ifac[i];
  }
  v[n]=1;
  for (RG int i=n;i;--i){
    if (!v[i]) continue;
    for (RG int j=i;j;(--j)&=i) v[j]=1;
  }
  for (RG int i=1;i<m;i<<=1)
    for (RG int j=0;j<=n;++j) if (j&i) add(f[j],f[j^i],1);
  for (RG int i=0;i<=n;++i) if (v[i]) fpm(f[i],k);
  for (RG int i=1;i<m;i<<=1)
    for (RG int j=0;j<=n;++j) if (j&i) add(f[j],f[j^i],0);
  cout<<(qpow(k,n)-1LL*f[n][cnt[n]]*fac[n]%rhl+rhl)%rhl; return 0;
}
